purpose: Teach: 水害/カラフル/陰陽/大連/一眼/絹/敷居/ベーコン

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、水害ボランティアから帰ってこられたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Did you hear? That customer who was volunteering after the flooding — they came back.
lines.style: Warm observation, unhurried. Gentle lift on the opening like sharing something noticed. Soft, almost tender delivery. Pauses slightly before the reveal, like Mei is savoring the detail.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニューはカラフルなトッピングにしましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: You know, we should make the new menu items more colorful with the toppings.
lines.style: Practical and present-focused. Steady, forward-looking tone. A small lift of quiet enthusiasm — not pushy, just offering the idea as something that feels right. Collaborative, not directive.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、陰陽道のお話されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer was talking about yin and yang philosophy the other day.
lines.style: Reflective, almost wondering. Soft sustained note on the memory. Speaking slowly, as if turning the conversation over in her mind. Genuine interest in what was shared, not just reporting it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、大連旅行のお土産を分けて下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And that customer shared souvenirs from their Dalian trip with us.
lines.style: Warm, appreciative. Slight brightness on the kindness of the gesture. Quiet pleasure in the memory — not gushing, just genuinely touched. Ends with a small, satisfied breath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店に新しい一眼レフを置きたいね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Wouldn't it be nice if we put a good camera in the shop? A real one, I mean.
lines.style: Gentle wondering, almost wistful. Soft opening — checking if it's a dream worth saying out loud. Slow, thoughtful pace. The question carries hope more than expectation.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、絹のハンカチを大事にされていたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer took such good care of their silk handkerchief — you could tell it meant something to them.
lines.style: Observant and tender. Notice the small act of care without judgment. Slow, appreciative delivery. Ends softly, like Mei is honoring something private she witnessed.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店の敷居を低くして入りやすくしましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: What if we made the entrance feel less formal? More inviting.
lines.style: Thoughtful proposal, warm underneath. Measured pace. Speaking like someone who's been thinking about this quietly. Collaborative tone — offering the thought gently, not prescribing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニュー、ベーコンサンド作りましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: We should definitely add a bacon sandwich to the new menu.
lines.style: Lighter, more animated than before. A small spark of concrete enthusiasm. Quick tempo, decisive but never bossy. Ends with quiet conviction, like she's seen this working in her mind already.
